question: How many years are required to renew the loss of 10 cm of soil?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Explanation:** The passage mentions that if 10 cm of soil is lost, it will take **1,000 **years to get it back.
 
• This emphasizes the fragility and **the long time required for soil regeneration.**
 
• In summary, **option 2 '1,000' is the correct answer as it accurately reflects the information provided in the passage about the time required to renew the loss of 10 cm of soil.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1,00,000:** This time duration is mentioned nowhere in the passage and is an overestimation.
 
• **100:** This is an underestimated duration compared to the information given in the passage.
 
• **10,000:** This is also an overestimation and is not supported by the passage.
